shortlist.story: India deployed an AI chatbot called Khushi, built on BharatGPT, to answer tuberculosis questions and guide patients to nearby health centres.
shortlist.best_title: India launches Khushi AI chatbot to aid tuberculosis patients
shortlist.why: Real deployment in a country with a severe TB burden; AI is the direct mechanism connecting patients to care; two outlets confirm it launched.

shortlist.story: An AI flood-warning system is being rolled out in Dublin this week, giving residents more lead time to prepare for flooding.
shortlist.best_title: New AI flood warning system to be rolled out in Dublin this week with 'time most valuable thing' to help people prepare
shortlist.why: Deployment is imminent/current, not hypothetical; climate/nature topic; real community at risk; item 38 is specific about timing and benefit while item 33 corroborates it.

shortlist.story: A person living with ALS used AI to decode their brain signals and produce singing, allowing them to make music despite losing motor control.
shortlist.best_title: ALS Singer Sings via AI Brain Signals
shortlist.why: Specific real person, compelling accessibility story; AI is the reason music is possible; likely based on a documented case or demo.

shortlist.story: An AI learning tool is helping blind students in Malawi achieve academic success.
shortlist.best_title: AI learning tool helps blind students excel in Malawi
shortlist.why: Real students, real place, real reported outcome; AI is the enabling factor for access to education; Al Jazeera sourcing adds credibility.

shortlist.story: A Bolivian engineer built the first AI system capable of speaking Aymara, an indigenous language, and Bolivian officials are already using it.
shortlist.best_title: Bolivian Engineer Built the First AI That Speaks Aymara — and Officials Are Already Using It
shortlist.why: Real use, not a plan; language preservation for a living indigenous language; named country and identifiable creator; compelling for a non-tech audience.

shortlist.story: Researchers at Mass General Brigham developed a deep-learning algorithm that uses MRI scans to predict, before surgery, whether deep brain stimulation will help patients with dystonia.
shortlist.best_title: Research spotlight: Novel algorithm predicts brain surgery outcomes in dystonia patients
shortlist.why: Peer-reviewed study from a credible institution; AI is the reason surgeons could have foresight they currently lack; real patients, real condition.

shortlist.story: Utah is running a formal trial to test whether AI can safely diagnose patients and prescribe medications.
shortlist.best_title: Utah tests if AI can safely diagnose patients, prescribe medication
shortlist.why: A real trial is under way, not a proposal; health topic; AI is directly the subject under test; real place and real patients involved.

shortlist.story: The City of Tampere used AI to deliver a long-requested improvement for users of eVaka, its municipal childcare management system.
shortlist.best_title: eVaka users' wish came true thanks to artificial intelligence [City of Tampere]
shortlist.why: A city government reporting a completed real-world AI deployment; AI is stated as the reason it was possible; direct source is the city itself.

shortlist.story: California's attorney general sued OpenAI, alleging the company built dangerous AI products without adequate safety safeguards.
shortlist.best_title: California sues OpenAI, alleges it endangered the public by building AI without safeguards
shortlist.why: Widely covered bad-AI story; good side is 'the system is responding' — a state using its legal system to demand accountability from an AI company; no person was physically hurt or defrauded.

shortlist.story: AI-automated cyberattacks were detected in real-world use for the first time, with Google identifying and publicly disclosing the events.
shortlist.best_title: In a first, Google detects AI-automated cyberattack
shortlist.why: Widely covered security scare; good side is 'owning up' — Google detected and disclosed the attack publicly, giving defenders a documented blueprint to respond; no person was physically injured or defrauded.
